skills.name: Common-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the common denominator.

skills.name: Unlike-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Use equivalent fractions to create a common denominator and subtract fractions with unlike denominators.

skills.name: Mixed-number subtraction without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract mixed numbers, whole numbers, or fractions by coordinating whole-number and fractional parts when no borrowing is needed.

skills.name: Regrouping in subtraction
skills.definition: Rewrite one whole from the minuend as an equivalent fraction when the fractional part is missing or too small to subtract.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed numbers
skills.definition: Interpret or convert mixed numbers whose fractional part is improper before subtracting.
